approvedBy: UNAPPROVED — this version exists to record what is open, not to permit storage
_note: VERSION 0 CONFIGURES NO RETENTION PERIODS, AND THAT IS THE POINT.
Every entry below is UNRESOLVED. Nothing can be stored under this version, which is the
correct state until someone with the relevant competence reads the named sources and
decides. See docs/retention-analysis.md for the reasoning and the framework.
UK GDPR does not prescribe retention periods for any of these document types. Article
5(1)(e) requires that personal data be kept no longer than is necessary for the purposes,
and Article 5(2) requires the controller to be able to demonstrate that. So the period is
ours to justify — which is a heavier duty than being handed a number, not a lighter one.
These entries were raised by Claude, which COULD NOT READ ANY OF THE NAMED SOURCES: the
build environment blocks ico.org.uk, legislation.gov.uk and gov.uk. Each 'expectedBasisKind'
is a reading of where the answer is likely to come from, and is marked as a reading.
